about: Trees the tree layer leaves out because the owner's own photographs show there is no tree there (the photo wins over map data). Each entry is a tree's position in safe_city.json / safe_osm.json (v2 frame, metres); v2/trees.js drops any tree within match_m of it. Add one entry per tree, with why.

trees.why: McCombs east (CBA South) entrance: a 7.6 m oak drawn on the stair landing; the owner's photo of that entrance shows the stair, a lamp post right of it and no tree

McCombs north glass hall (CBA North): an 8.3 m tree drawn 15 m in front of the hall, between the owner's camera and the doors; his photo from that spot shows a clear view of the hall with only a lamp post
